content: Yesu Akanguisa Yala ua Semukile Vupuputua
Tele Yesu alinakuenda, uamuene yala uje ua semukile vupuputua.
Vandongisi vendi vamuhuile nguavo, “Mulongisi, iya ualingile vupi, ou yala indi visemi vendi, linga a semuke vupuputua?”
Yesu uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Voshe kuvalingile vupi, uasemukile vupuputua linga vipangi via Njambi visholoke muli ikeye.
Tuapande kupanga vipangi viendi uje uanjitumine tuyeni tupange ntsimbu kucili mutania, omo vutsiki vukeja tukahona kupanga.
Ntsimbu njicili ha mavu, njinapu ceke ca vaka mavu.”
Omo uamanusuile kuhandeka evi, uajekuililile ha mavu kaha uambatele mavu a kupandakana na malenzi naku ahaka ha mesho a uje yala,
nakuhandeka kuli ikeye nguendi, “Ya, ukatane ku mesho ove mu cisali ca Siloame” (Siloame ilumbunuka vana mutumu). Kaha uaile nakutana omo uahilukile uaputukile kumona.
Vandambo vendi na vaje vamumuene laja tele acili muka kulomba vukuasi, vaputukile kuihula nguavo, “Ou keti ikeye uje yala uakele nakutumama na kulomba vukuasi ndi?”
Vamo vaputukile kuhandeka nguavo, “Ikeye vene.” Vamo vahandekele nguavo, “houe, vuno honi muntu lika ueka uakulifua nendi.” Kaha ikeye uahandekele nguendi, “Yange vene uje yala.”
Vuno honi vatualeleleho kumuihula nguavo, “Kaha mesho ove anemuka vati?”
Uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Yala ivatumbula nguavo Yesu uambatele mavu nakunjihaka ha mesho, nakuhandeka kuli yange nguendi, ‘Ya ku Siloame ukatane.’ Kaha njaile nakutana mukemo njaputukile kumona.”
Vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Ali kuli honi?” Uahandekele nguendi, “Kunjitantekeya.”
Vafaliseo Vatondesesa ha Kukanguisa eci
Vanehele uje yala uapuile kapuputua kuli Vafaliseo.
Liapuile litangua lia Sapalalo lije Yesu uemuisile uje yala.
Kaha Vafaliseo naua vaputukile kumuihula nguavo, cineja vati linga umone. Uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Uanjihakele mavu ha mesho ange. Kaha njataneneko, mukemo njili nakumona.”

Vamo va Vafaliseo vahandekele nguavo, “Ou yala kahumu kuli Njambi, omuo kekuniunga litangua lia sapalalo.” Vuno honi vakuavo vahandekele nguavo, “Muka vupi asa vati kulinga vitantekeyeso evi?” Kaha vali hangunuine.
Kaha Vafaliseo vahandekele naua kuli uje kapuputua nguavo, “Uhandekaho vika hali ikeye? Mesho ove akeo anemuisile.” Uahandekele nguendi, “Ikeye Kananguizi ua Njambi.”
Vakuluntu va Vayunda kuvatsilielele nguavo uapuile kapuputua kaha ali nakumona naua, kuvanga noho vasanene visemi va uje yala ivemuisile
nakuvehula nguavo, “Ou ikeye vene muneni, uje imuahandekele ngueni nasemuka vupuputua ndi? Cija vatihoni linga amone?”
Visemi vendi vakumbuluile nguavo, “Tuatantekeya vene nguetu ou ikeye munetu, naua ikeye vene uje uasemukile vupuputua,
vuno honi kutuatantekeyele cije canehesa linga amone, kaha kutuatantekeyele naua nauje nemuisa mesho endi. Muhuliseni, mukuluntu alihandekela ikeye vavenia.”
Visemi vendi vahandekele eci omuo vateuele vantuama va Vayunda, omuo vantuama va Vayunda valitavasanene nguavo uoshe ahandeka nguendi Yesu ikeye Kilistu vakamusheka mu njivo ya malombelo.
Nankuma visemi vendi vahandekele nguavo, “Nakolo, muhuliseni.”
Nankuma vasanene uje yala uapuile kapuputua lua mucivali, kaha vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Hana kalemeso kuli Njambi! Tuatantekeya nguetu ou yala napu muka vupi.”
Uakumbuluile nguendi, “Kunjitantekeya indi muka vupi indi kuahi. Cuma cimo cinjitantekeya lika nguange njapuile njikapuputua, vuno honi hano njimona.”
Vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Nalingile vika kuli yove? Nakuimuisa vati?”
Uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Njamilekesa laja, vuno honi ku muanjivuilile. Vika mutondela naua kucivua? Neni naua mutonda kupua vandongisi vendi ndi?”
Kaha vaputukile nakuhandeka nguavo, “Yove ndongisi uendi, vuno honi yetu tuvandongisi va Mosesa.
Tuatantekeya nguetu Njambi uahandekele kuli Mosesa, vuno honi hali ou yala, kutuatantekeyele kuje kuahuma.”
Uje yala uakumbuluile nguendi, “Eci cinapu cuma cakukomouesa! Kumuatantekeyele kuje ahuminina, vuno honi nemuisa mesho ange.
Tuatantekeya nguetu Njambi kekuivuilila kuva ka vupi, vuno honi akevuilila kuli uje muka kumulemesa na uje muka kuononoka cizango cendi.
Hume kuva tangelele mavu, naumo uahi uevua muntu uje emuisa muntu uasemukile vupuputua.
Nga ou yala kahumine kuli Njambi, ngue nevi ali nakulinga viahi.”
Vamukumbuluile nguavo, “Yove uasemukililile mu vupi, nkuma utonda kutulongesa ndi?” Kaha vamushekele mu njivo ya malombelo.
Vupuputua vuamu Cimbembesi
Omo Yesu uevuile nguavo vanamusheke, kaha omo uamuuanene, uahandekele nguendi, “Uatsiliela muli Muna Muntu ndi?”
Uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Napu iya, Muene? Njileke, linga njimutsiliele.”
Yesu uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Uamumono, nou ali nakuhandeka kuli yove ikeye vene.”
Uahandekele nguendi, “Muene, njitsiliela.” Kaha uamulemesele.
Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Njezile hano ha mavu mu kusompa linga vaje kuvamono linga vamone, naua navaje vamona linga keti vamone.”
Vamo va Vafaliseo vaje vakele hayehi nendi vovuile eci vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Cili vene netu naua tutupuputua ndi?”
Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Nga muapuile tupuputua, ngue kumuesi na vupi. Vuno honi muhandeka ngueni, ‘Tumona,’ vupi vueni hanga vuakala.”
